measured: Application calls and optional settings are recorded below at the cited commits.

backend.call: resend.emails.send({ from, to, subject, text }): the platform's own mail (a member added or invited, a World deleted, the biller's notices)

applications.name: twin-world's platform callers (the Postiz cookbook and vendor-backed root)
applications.client: fetch against the resend twin and api.resend.com

backend.call: GET /domains, POST /domains, POST /domains/{id}/verify: Postiz's sending domain, added and verified through Resend's API

applications.name: Resend derived refresh (twin-packs-p3)
applications.client: kernel RemoteExecute through the pack manifest

backend.call: a vendor-backed root refreshes the team's emails and domains from their lists (architecture, The real-system adapters: Refresh)
Vendor-backed refresh reads received emails from their native whole-account list and detail operations
resend.emails.send({ from: 'Name <address>', to, subject, html, reply_to? }): every mail Postiz sends with EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend
resend.emails.send: every transactional email (from, to, subject, react/html, text, replyTo, headers, tags); scheduledAt is passed from the batch-email cron payload
resend.batch.send: up to 100 emails in one call (partner and program notifications)
resend.domains.create({ name }): a program's email domain
resend.domains.create({ name }): the domain renamed
resend.domains.update({ id, openTracking: true, clickTracking: false, tls: 'enforced' }): the domain's settings, from the queued job after its creation
resend.domains.get: its records and status (forwarding instructions)
resend.domains.get: its records, applied through Domain Connect
resend.domains.get: its status before verifying
resend.domains.verify: start verification once the records are set
resend.domains.remove: a domain left when its creation fails
resend.domains.remove: a domain renamed or deleted

webhooks.call: Resend's webhooks to /api/resend/webhook, verified with svix (RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET): email.opened, email.delivered, email.bounced, each read by data.email_id

applications.name: dubinc/dub
applications.gate: Resend is the first-choice shipped mail transport; SMTP is an automatic credential fallback, without a provider switch (packages/email/src/index.ts:6-23).

applications.name: calcom/cal.diy

backend.call: Nodemailer SMTP submission to smtp.resend.com
backend.operation: SMTP submission (served by smtp, not a Resend REST operation)

applications.gate: The shipped mail transport selects smtp.resend.com when its credential is supplied; it uses Nodemailer SMTP, not Resend REST (packages/lib/serverConfig.ts:8-20).

optional.what: Transactional mail through the selected resend provider.
optional.setting: Configuration opt-in (1): EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend selects a non-default mail provider. libraries/nestjs-libraries/src/services/email.service.ts:13 reads the setting; :26-33 selects Resend or Nodemailer and defaults to EmptyProvider at :32-33. Sender and transport credentials authorize the selected provider; they do not select it.

backend.call: resend.emails.send({ from: 'Name <address>', to, subject, html, reply_to? }): every mail Postiz sends with EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend
POST /emails: one outbound mail from a workspace's emailing domain including base64 attachment content, filename and content_type
POST /emails/batch: several at once
POST /domains { name, region? }: the workspace's emailing domain, when the list names none
GET /domains/{id}: its records and status
GET /domains: the team's domains, searched by name
POST /domains/{id}/verify
DELETE /domains/{id}
GET /emails/{id}: a sent email
GET /emails/receiving/{id}: an inbound reply, then its raw message at raw.download_url (pre-signed, no Authorization; the inbound-cdn screen)

webhooks.call: Resend's webhooks verified with svix: email.received (inbound), email.delivered, email.bounced, email.complained, email.failed

optional.setting: Configuration (1): EMAILING_DOMAIN_DRIVER=RESEND replaces LOG; this concerns emailing-domain provisioning, not SMTP messaging (packages/twenty-server/src/engine/core-modules/twenty-config/config-variables.ts:2364).

screens.who: An operator uses the Emails dashboard to inspect the messages their application sent through the unchanged Resend SDK.
screens.evidence: Official Emails table and Email Details references recorded in spec/SOURCE.md before authoring.
screens.scope: List and details, recorded events, Preview, Plain Text and HTML. No dashboard sends, authentication, share links or engagement totals.
